senses.gloss: m. (κοσμοκράτωρ) lord of the world, cosmocrator (a title of the Roman emperor); in gen. universal chief. Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 והיו … שיהיה ק׳ על כל המלכים all kings came and crowned him (Pharaoh) the cosmocrator over all kings; Ex. R. s. 5 שהוא יום ק׳ (corr. acc.). Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ bot. ואם תאמר ק׳ וכ׳ and if you say, he is cosmocrator, he rules over the dry land, does he rule over the sea?; Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ top קוזמוקל׳.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:10">Esth. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>כל מלך שאינו ק׳ וכ׳</he> no king that is not cosmocrator of the world, dare sit in it (Solomon’s throne).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>הק״בה … קזמיק׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) the Lord has made him (Joseph) a ruler, and should I not do him honor? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:1">Cant. R. to VIII, 6</cite> <he>אע״פ שמניתיך ספיקולטור ק׳ על וכ׳</he> (not <he>קפוקלטור</he>) although I have appointed thee chief executioner of my creatures &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שעשיתיך קוזמוקטור</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S00277"><he>קוֹזְמוֹקְרָטוֹרִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58:4">Gen. R. s. 58</cite> <he>שרדף … ארבע מלכיות ק׳</he> (read: <he>מלכים</he>) he (Abraham) pursued four kings with the titles of cosmocrator. Esth. R. introd. to I, 9 <he>שלשה … ק׳ מסוף וכ׳</he> three kings that shall be rulers from end to end of the world; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>קוזמוקרוטין</he> (corr. acc.); Pesik. Shek., p. 14ᵃ <he>קוזמוקלוט׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 247">Yalk. Kings 247</cite> <he>קוזמוקוט׳</he>, <he>קוזמוקיט׳</he> (corr. acc.).
